```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(pracma)
library(plotly)
library(shiny)
library(stats)
```


$$Y_t = f(X) + \epsilon_t, \qquad \epsilon_t \stackrel{iid}{\sim} N(0, \sigma_n^2) \\
f(t) \sim GP(0, K(X, X')), \qquad K(X, X') = \sigma_f^2 e^{-\frac{1}{2\ell^2}||X - X'||}$$
```{r}
# Kernel Function
kernel <- function(t1, t2, sigma_input, ell_input) {
  sigma_input^2 * exp(- (t1 - t2)^2 / (2 * ell_input^2))
}

# Log marginal likelihood
log_marginal_likelihood <- function(params, X, y) {
  sigma_f <- params[1]
  sigma_n <- params[2]
  ell <- params[3]
  n <- length(X)
  
  K <- outer(X, X, kernel, sigma_f, ell)
  L <- chol(K + sigma_n^2 * diag(n))
  alpha <- mldivide(t(L), mldivide(L, y))
  
  lml <- (-1/2) * t(y) %*% alpha - sum(log(diag(L))) - (n/2) * log(2 * pi)
  return(as.numeric(lml))
}
```

```{r}
# UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Gaussian Process Regression - Interactive Hyperparameters"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("sigma_f", 
                  "Signal Variance (σ_f):",
                  min = 0.1, max = 3, value = 1.08, step = 0.05),
      
      sliderInput("sigma_n", 
                  "Noise Variance (σ_n):",
                  min = 0.00001, max = 1, value = 0.00005, step = 0.00001),
      
      sliderInput("ell", 
                  "Length Scale (ℓ):",
                  min = 5e-10, max = 0.1 , value = 0.3, step = 0.005),
      
      hr(),
      actionButton("resample", "Resample Data"),
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("gpPlot", height = "600px")
    )
  )
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive value to store the data
  data <- reactiveVal()
  
  # Initialize data on startup
  observe({
    set.seed(123)
    n <- 20
    X <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = n)
    K <- outer(X, X, kernel, 1.08, 0.3)
    f <- mvrnorm(1, rep(0, n), K)
    y <- f + rnorm(n, 0, 0.00005)
    data(list(X = X, y = y))
  })
  
  # Resample data when button is clicked
  observeEvent(input$resample, {
    n <- 20
    X <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = n)
    K <- outer(X, X, kernel, input$sigma_f, input$ell)
    f <- mvrnorm(1, rep(0, n), K)
    y <- f + rnorm(n, 0, input$sigma_n)
    data(list(X = X, y = y))
  })
  
  # Compute predictions reactively
  predictions <- reactive({
    req(data())
    
    X <- data()$X
    y <- data()$y
    n <- length(X)
    
    # Get hyperparameters from sliders
    sigma_f <- input$sigma_f
    sigma_n <- input$sigma_n
    ell <- input$ell
    
    # Prediction for new input X*
    X_star <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = 200)
    
    K <- outer(X, X, kernel, sigma_f, ell)
    K_star <- outer(X, X_star, kernel, sigma_f, ell)
    K_starstar <- outer(X_star, X_star, kernel, sigma_f, ell)
    
    # Algorithm 2.1 from Rasmussen Textbook
    L <- chol(K + sigma_n^2 * diag(n))
    alpha <- mldivide(t(L), mldivide(L, y))
    v <- mldivide(L, K_star)
    
    mean <- t(K_star) %*% alpha          #predictive mean
    var <- K_starstar - t(v) %*% v       #predictive variance
    
    #lower and upper 95% confidence bounds
    q1 <- mean + qnorm(0.05, 0, sqrt(pmax(diag(var), 1e-10)))
    q2 <- mean + qnorm(0.95, 0, sqrt(pmax(diag(var), 1e-10)))
    
    list(X_star = X_star, mean = mean, q1 = q1, q2 = q2)
  })
  
  # Render plot
  output$gpPlot <- renderPlot({
    req(data(), predictions())
    
    pred <- predictions()
    dat <- data()
    
    plot(dat$X, dat$y, pch = 4, col = "blue", cex = 1.5,
         xlab = "input, X", ylab = "output, y",
         main = paste0("GP Regression (σ_f=", input$sigma_f, 
                      ", σ_n=", input$sigma_n, 
                      ", ℓ=", input$ell, ")"),
         cex.lab = 1.2, cex.main = 1.2)
    
    # Add confidence interval
    polygon(c(pred$X_star, rev(pred$X_star)), 
            c(pred$q1, rev(pred$q2)),
            col = rgb(0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 0.3), border = NA)
    
    # Add mean line
    lines(pred$X_star, pred$mean, lwd = 2, col = "blue")
    
    # Add confidence bounds
    lines(pred$X_star, pred$q1, lwd = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray30")
    lines(pred$X_star, pred$q2, lwd = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray30")
    
    # Re-add points on top
    points(dat$X, dat$y, pch = 4, col = "blue", cex = 1.5, lwd = 2)
    
    # Add legend
    legend("topright", 
           legend = c("Data", "Mean", "95% CI"),
           col = c("blue", "blue", "gray30"),
           lty = c(NA, 1, 2),
           pch = c(4, NA, NA),
           lwd = c(2, 2, 1))
  })
}

# Run the app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 20
X <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = n)
K <- outer(X, X, kernel, 1.08, 0.3)
f <- mvrnorm(1, rep(0, n), K)
y <- f + rnorm(n, 0, 0.00005)

# Grid Search
sigma_f_grid <- seq(0.5, 2, length.out = 15)      # Around the true 1.08
sigma_n_grid <- seq(0.00001, 0.001, length.out = 15)  # Small noise range
ell_grid <- seq(0.1, 1.5, length.out = 15)         # Around the true 0.3

best_params = c(NA, NA, NA)
best_lml = -Inf

for (sigma_f in sigma_f_grid) {
  for (ell in ell_grid) {
    for (sigma_n in sigma_n_grid) {
      lml <- log_marginal_likelihood(c(sigma_f, sigma_n, ell), X, y)
      if (lml > best_lml) {
        best_lml <- lml
        best_params <- c(sigma_f = sigma_f, sigma_n = sigma_n, ell = ell)
      }
    }
  }
}

sigma_f_opt <- best_params[1]
sigma_n_opt <- best_params[2]
ell_opt     <- best_params[3]
cat("Optimal hyperparameters:\n")
cat("sigma_f =", sigma_f_opt, "\n")
cat("sigma_n =", sigma_n_opt, "\n")
cat("ell     =", ell_opt, "\n")

# Algorithm 2.1 from Rasmussen Textbook
X_star <- seq(-6, 6, length.out = 200)

K <- outer(X, X, kernel, sigma_f_opt, ell_opt)
K_star <- outer(X, X_star, kernel, sigma_f_opt, ell_opt)
K_starstar <- outer(X_star, X_star, kernel, sigma_f_opt, ell_opt)

L <- chol(K + sigma_n_opt^2 * diag(n))
alpha <- backsolve(t(L), forwardsolve(L, y))
v <- forwardsolve(L, K_star)

mean_pred <- t(K_star) %*% alpha
var_pred <- K_starstar - t(v) %*% v
q1 <- mean_pred + qnorm(0.05, 0, sqrt(pmax(diag(var_pred), 0)))
q2 <- mean_pred + qnorm(0.95, 0, sqrt(pmax(diag(var_pred), 0)))

plot(X, y, pch=4, col="blue", xlab="input, X", ylab="output, y")
lines(X_star, mean_pred, lwd=1, col="blue")
lines(X_star, q1, lwd=1, lty=2, col="gray")
lines(X_star, q2, lwd=1, lty=2, col="gray")
```
